caption_L1: New York Knicks operating income from 2001/02 to 2018/19 (in million U.S. dollars) is a bar chart. The x-axis plots Year while the y-axis measures Operating income in million U.S. dollars.
caption_L2L3: Income during the three years commencing 01/02 was modest but steady. The subsequent three years showed a decline into increasingly negative territory. Recovery commenced with a return to positive income during 07/08, with a strong upward trend continuing through to 18/19. However, there were two brief dips during 08/09 and 13/14.
